bio.text: Cindy Winckler, a Democrat, represents District 49 in the Iowa Senate; the Iowa Legislature's biography lists Winckler as serving a first Senate term after 11 terms in the Iowa House.
The biography lists a B.S. in home economics from Truman State University and an M.A. in educational technology from the University of Northern Iowa.

It also lists Winckler as a past national president of Business and Professional Women/USA and a former member of the Davenport Zoning Board of Adjustment, and says Winckler was born in Des Moines and lives in Davenport.
